status: prospective; fixed before new frame-ceiling timings
scope: Experimental pre-shadev material queue; original XPU retained; no install, defaults or merge

exactness.one_worker: All finite float32 RGBA words identical, including signed zero; metadata and dimensions identical
exactness.kernel: Same CPU/ISPC arithmetic and order; no FMA/fast-math shortcut; no hardware texture filtering

twelve_workers.definition: Per fixture and channel, freeze maxima over all reference/reference pairs. Each candidate/reference pair must meet every metric; no margin or refit after candidate results.

speed.disabled_regression_limit: median MCRT overhead <= max(3% original, 0.1 s); report spread and no speedup if ranges overlap
speed.speedup: normal must be faster than original and image-qualified; 30-40% remains a target, not permission to change quality

cpu_ceiling.estimator: exclusive sampled elapsed seconds * inclusion rate (Horvitz-Thompson); also retain lane-weighted diagnostic
cpu_ceiling.caveat: At 12 workers the sum is worker elapsed seconds, not removable wall time; includes preemption and internal waits. Two sampling rates show sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

queue.claim: exactly one terminal publish per generation/sample; no CPU graph evaluation before ownership rejection or spot check
queue.spot_check_identity: stable scene generation, pixel, sample, depth and material revision; never queue arrival order
queue.lighting: GPU light queue disabled until actually consumed and qualified
queue.residency: commit only after upload completion; retain immutable revisions for flights; generation mismatch rejects without black-success

material_selection: Inspect actual Modo exporter; do not assume the eight-layer cost fixture is the common export
acceptance: No gate may be relaxed after seeing timings; incomplete and failed evidence remain visible
